name: marketing-ideas
description: Checks whether a marketing idea can pay for the customers it brings before money is spent. From a product description it builds a context card (buyer, price, margin, demand state, existing assets), proposes one concrete idea per channel family, removes ideas that break disclosure or platform rules or lack a source of buyers, scores the rest with an evidence grade and returns one main bet plus two cheap probes. For a single idea it prints the most you can afford per customer, signup and click and whether a quoted cost fits. It writes test cards with pass and stop lines set before launch and a sample-size check, and reads channel test results with intervals. Every number is the user's or a labelled assumption.
